visibility.display_rule: Exactly 1 hides. The other tested values0,2,3 display publicly. On editor load, all non1 values normalize to3.
visibility.master: FO=1 hides Card Level, Title, Average Rank together; Player Name and Purpose still render.

transport.service: Configured PFC service identity at10323F28/2C; current game initializer uses service-table index1 (GTM0P)
transport.request_fields: identity as0x+16 hex digits, then ACK byte06, then decimal character key
transport.not_file_service: These PG/GR messages use game IRC; do not send them as profile-file transactions.

PG.copy: On success, copies0xE8 bytes once and clears output pointer. Further polls still return1 without recopying.
PG.cancel: 101A66A0 resets pending state and internal record
PG.identity_check: Shown completion callback does not compare sender or locator; it only requires pending state1 and selected classifier.

GR.busy_behavior: No busy rejection; new request resets its state and can replace outstanding GR.
GR.extra_tags: Both NO tags must survive. Use ordered repeated tags or selector-keyed settings; a plain tag-name map loses one.
